title: Lane C P1.1: Provider Invocation Evidence Contract and Usage Truth Normalization
summary: Delivered a package-owned normalized provider invocation outcome evidence contract that distinguishes requested from actual provider/model identity, classifies outcomes consistently (success/refusal/safety_block/error), preserves cache token evidence as named fields, represents gateway provenance without fabricating certainty, and provides a read-only invocation evidence capability inspection surface. Extended LLMUsage with cache_read_tokens and cache_creation_tokens. Preserved Anthropic cache token evidence as distinct named fields. 27 new tests; 140 total pass with all P1 regressions clean.

sections.content: ProviderInvocationOutcome is a dataclass with 30+ fields covering identity (requested/actual provider and model), classification (provider_class, api_style), outcome (outcome_class, refusal_class, summary), execution mode (streaming, latency), usage evidence (input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_creation_tokens), gateway provenance (downstream_provider, downstream_model, provenance_source), safe content hashes, content-light guarantee, and 8 explicit availability flags. All usage/cache/provenance/identity fields default to None (unavailable/not verified) — the contract forces explicit truth, not fabricated certainty.

Invariants enforced: (1) API compatibility does not collapse provider identity — DeepSeek using openai api_style is still provider_id='deepseek', provider_class=DIRECT_INFERENCE. (2) OpenRouter is classified as ROUTED_GATEWAY even though its api_style is 'openai'. (3) Cache tokens are named fields, not summed into prompt_tokens. (4) Gateway provenance is None by default, only populated when extraction is verified. (5) Content-light enforced by assert_content_light() scanning for sk-/Bearer/key/secret patterns. (6) All availability flags default to None (not verified) — explicit opt-in for every field.

Anthropic is the only adapter with verified cache token evidence. P1.1 updated AnthropicAdapter to emit cache_read_tokens and cache_creation_tokens as named LLMUsage fields instead of summing them into prompt_tokens. Both non-streaming (parse_response) and streaming (message_start handler) paths updated. Cache tokens default to 0 when not present in the response.

Gemini adapter (P1) correctly maps usage (promptTokenCount → prompt_tokens, candidatesTokenCount → completion_tokens). Safety refusal detection (SAFETY_BLOCK, SAFETY_REFUSAL) correctly performed. The ProviderInvocationOutcome contract is proven to represent these outcomes (test_gemini_safety_block_maps_to_safety_outcome, test_gemini_success_with_usage, test_gemini_error_maps_to_error_outcome). The Gemini adapter does not yet return a ProviderInvocationOutcome (it returns LLMChunk as all adapters do) — wiring the invocation outcome into the live execution path is deferred to a subsequent slice that coordinates with the backend execution layer. The contract exists, the mapping is proven, and the read-boundary truthfully reports what is available.

invocation_evidence_capabilities() returns InvocationEvidenceCapability records for 6 providers. No network calls. No secrets. No inference. No persistence. The surface answers: which adapters produce verified token usage, verified cache evidence, verified safety/refusal classification, verified actual provider/model identity, verified streaming final usage, and verified gateway provenance. get_invocation_evidence_capability(provider_id) returns a single capability record. Both functions produce identical results on repeated calls (idempotent).

ProviderInvocationOutcome is designed for future Lane B consumption without importing Lane B evidence stores or desktop code. When Lane B is ready to ingest invocation evidence into operational projections, it should: (1) accept a content-light provider invocation outcome record; (2) display provider/model usage distributions, cache effectiveness, safety refusal rates, and gateway provenance completeness; (3) never receive raw prompts, generated text, tool arguments, or API keys through the invocation evidence contract. The contract uses to_dict() for serialization compatibility and assert_content_light() as the content-light validation gate. No persistence is implemented in P1.1 — Lane B owns the operational persistence layer.
